text: A fast transfer costs the greater of $5.99 or 1.75% of the transfer amount, capped at $25. This is stated in both the Fast Transfers help article and the Deposit Account Agreement. One section of the Albert Cash Account Agreement lists a $4.99 fee, which doesn't match, so check the fee shown in the app (Profile > Transfer money) before you confirm. A free ACH withdrawal is also available, but it can take up to 2-3 business days.
